items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's mention of Walter Grundy, indicating no personal connection or memory of him.

ctx.x: Mac Murray, oh. Before your time.

Walter Grundy, every year, didn't he? But Walter? He played with the bunk way back, then he took out the taranet. I didn't see it before your time. No, no, I didn't know him. Well, we're just about out of the tape here. Unless there's something else that you want to add?
Well, there ain't nothing else I could say. We're all of the day.
